title: Netflix: From DVDs to Streaming Giant
description: Learn Netflix: From DVDs to Streaming Giant in one minute.

hook.text: Netflix started in 1997 mailing DVDs in red envelopes. No late fees, no store visits.

buildup.text: In 2007, Netflix launched streaming. Watch instantly — no disc, no waiting.

discovery.text: Recommendation algorithms learned your taste and kept you watching for hours.

twist.text: Blockbuster turned down a chance to buy Netflix for $50 million. Blockbuster went bankrupt.

climax.text: Netflix killed the video rental industry and redefined how the world consumes entertainment.

punchline.text: DVDs in envelopes killed the video store.

quiz.question: What did Blockbuster do when offered Netflix?
